profile.name: Anas Flaifel
profile.title: SCADA & IoT Engineer
profile.intro: I connect operational data with clear, useful interfaces. At Spacia Systems, I work with Ignition and SQL Server on water-sector applications in Jordan.
profile.about: My core work brings together SCADA, databases, and IoT. I design database structures, develop application scripts, and connect Ignition interfaces to the data behind them.
profile.aboutMore: Alongside this work, I use Blender to create equipment models and bring them into SCADA through rendered animation frames. SVG-based 2.5D graphics offer another way to make industrial interfaces easier to understand.

projects.title: Water infrastructure SCADA development
projects.summary: Database and interface development across two ongoing water-sector projects, working with operational, consumption, and non-revenue water (NRW) data.
details: SCADA and operational-data applications for water infrastructure in Jordan. This overview brings together my responsibilities across two ongoing projects.
Database structure design, Ignition database integration, frontend interface development, and backend application scripting.
Working with large volumes of water-sector operational data, including consumption and non-revenue water (NRW) information.
Ignition and Microsoft SQL Server, with stored procedures, indexes, queries, and application scripts.
Keeping data access efficient and application logic maintainable as the volume of operational data grows.
Organizing database structures, using stored procedures to handle database-side logic, and applying indexing and query optimization to support the SCADA application.
Both projects are in development. Database and interface work is ongoing; final delivery and measured outcomes are not yet available.

capabilities.title: Data & backend
capabilities.body: SQL Server database design and integration, with stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization for large operational datasets.

capabilities.title: SCADA & interfaces
capabilities.body: Ignition interfaces connected to operational data, supported by frontend and backend scripting. SCADA and IoT form the core of my current work.
